body:
*Seizure Warning*
Dosed exactly half a blotter (500ug) and within 30 minutes I lost consciousness and had a massive grand mal seizure. I had been tripping alone, but luckily my dog miraculously alerted my family. By the time they found me I was still convulsing, with my eyes rolling back in my head. This was obviously extremely frightening to them and they instantly called the paramedics. Everything from that point on was a blur.
It's hard to think about the entire experience. To put the entire picture into perspective. This was the quintessential trip from hell. It was absolutely horrifying. But the worst part is putting my family through this.
I meticulously researched 25I-NBOMe and was fully aware of its dangerous safety profile. Having hundreds of psychedelic trips under my belt, and no history of seizures in the past, I thought of myself as the perfect candidate to responsibly and safely dose 25I. Boy, I couldn't have been more wrong.
Case in point - this could happen to anyone. No matter how careful you think you're being. Please be safe guys.
